title: Reach the date with a keyboard
goal: A customer who uses only the keyboard books the 09:00 slot on a chosen date, and the booking is saved and reopens with that exact date.

steps.headline: Keyboard user got stuck at the date step: there is no date field to Tab to

steps.diagnosis: The Flatpickr date picker lacks the allowInput option, preventing manual keyboard entry of the date in the #select-date field, causing the verifier's keyboard date entry to be ignored.
steps.evidence_explained: The verifier evidence shows focus trail reaching the date step but no indication that the date was entered; the page remains on the date step with the calendar UI visible, indicating the date input was not accepted.
steps.reasoning:
We need to diagnose why keyboard booking fails: likely date picker not accepting manual input via keyboard due to flatpickr config lacking allowInput. In booking.js datepicker init doesn't set allowInput:true, so typing date not accepted. Need to add allowInput: true. Also ensure onChange triggers getAvailableHours. So edit assets/js/pages/booking.js where App.Utils.UI.initializeDatePicker called. Add allowInput: true option.

Let's locate that line: see code: App.Utils.UI.initializeDatePicker($selectDate, { ... }) options include inline, minDate, maxDate, onChange, onMonthChange, onYearChange. We'll add allowInput: true.

Thus propose edit.

steps.headline: Keyboard user got stuck at the date step: there is no date field to Tab to

steps.diagnosis: The date picker container is a div, which cannot receive keyboard focus, so tabbing skips it. Changing it to an input element makes it focusable while preserving Flatpickr functionality.
steps.evidence_explained: The verifier evidence shows focus trail ending at the provider select and Next button, with no date field reached, and the verifier reported \"there is no date field to Tab to\". After clicking Next, focus lands on BODY, indicating the date step container is not focusable.
steps.reasoning:
We need to understand why the date field is not being focused. The verifier says there is no date field to Tab to. Possibly the date field is not rendered yet because the datepicker hasn't been initialized due to missing init? But we saw the JS initializes datepicker. However maybe the datepicker is hidden initially? Let's check the HTML: In booking_time_step.php, there is a div #select-date inside col-12 col-lg-6. That's likely where flatpickr attaches. It should be focusable if we give tabindex. But we tried that and didn't work. Maybe the issue is that the datepicker is not rendered until after a service/provider is selected? Actually the date step appears after selecting service and provider. The verifier successfully selected service and provider and clicked Next, moving to date step. So the date step should be visible. But the verifier's focus trail shows after pressing Enter on Next button, focus goes to BODY (no focus). That suggests that after clicking Next, focus is not managed; maybe the date field is not focusable because it's a flatpickr input that is hidden? Actually flatpickr wraps the input? In our code, we are using flatpickr on a div, not an input. Flatpickr when attached to a div creates a hidden input? Actually flatpickr can be attached to an input element; if attached to a div, it creates a wrapper? I think flatpickr expects an input. If we attach to a div, it may not create an input that can be focused. Thus the solution: change the div to an input element (type text) with id select-date, and keep the flatpickr initialization. Or we can keep div but ensure flatpickr makes it focusable by adding tabindex and maybe making it contenteditable? Better to change to input. Let's see if there is any other place expecting an input. The JS uses $selectDate as jQuery object of #select-date. It calls App.Utils.UI.initializeDatePicker($selectDate, ...). If $selectDate is a div, flatpickr may still work but the user cannot focus it. Changing to input should fix. Thus edit the PHP file: replace the div with an input. We also need to ensure it's not breaking anything else. We'll change:
to But we need to keep classes maybe. However the datepicker UI may be attached; we can keep the same classes. Simpler: change to input type="text" id="select-date" class="mx-auto my-4". We'll also remove tabindex because input is naturally focusable. Let's propose that edit. We'll also need to ensure that the datepicker still works; flatpickr can be attached to an input. Thus edit application/views/components/booking_time_step.php. Now produce proposal.
